questions.title: Is Claude Code better than Cursor?

content.text: The choice between Claude Code or Cursor depends on how you work, what you are building, and which interface fits your workflow.

Claude Code is better suited for execution-heavy tasks where delegation and automation matter more. Cursor fits interactive development workflows where fast feedback and visibility into changes are more important.
